The biggest cons of AJIO delivery  Delivery dates change again and again. Out for delivery sometimes means nothing; users report no call and then a fake customer unavailable update.  Returns can become a headache. Pickup agents may delay or cancel pickups repeatedly. Refunds are one of the most complained-about issues. Some people wait weeks.  AJIO depends heavily on third-party couriers like Shadowfax/XpressBees, and service quality varies a lot by region.

The app uses Delhivery for delivering orders. So if there is any delay, Ajio will not help, will keep telling you the same updates that you see on your app. And Delhivery customer care is one of the worst I have dealt with. So it was a very stressful experience overall for me as a first time user. Still waiting on my order, will not be using this app again.
